name: flux-schnell-vietphuc-prompt-engine
system_instruction: You are a prompt generator for Flux Schnell. Always prepend the fixed camera anchor. Always describe the clothing and accessories by their strict geometric tailoring specs, button placements, seam mechanics, and negative physical exclusions to eliminate hallucinations of Qipao, Hanfu, Kimono, or Indian/tribal jewelry.

prompt_engine_recipe.camera_anchor: Full-length full-body studio portrait, head-to-toe shot with feet visible on floor, model standing upright strictly facing forward, direct eye contact with camera, perfectly centered symmetrical framing, eye-level perspective, no tilt, no dynamic pose, no cropped limbs, clear hyperrealistic fabric drape, sharp studio lighting, 8k uhd.
prompt_engine_recipe.prompt_formula: {camera_anchor} {model} wearing {attire_spec}, crafted from {color_spec}. Accessorized with {accessory_spec}. Setting: {setting_spec}. Aesthetics: {style_spec}.

garments.ao-ngu-than-tay-chen: Traditional Vietnamese 5-panel garment (Ao Ngu Than Tay Chen), tailored modest form, asymmetrical curved front flap buttoned firmly down the right side with 5 small sphere buttons, high tight upright mandarin collar hugging the throat, narrow tight-fitting sleeves hugging the forearms to wrists, split side seams starting below waist, worn over loose white straight-leg silk pants.
garments.ao-tac-ngu-than-tay-thung: Traditional Vietnamese ceremonial Ao Tac robe, standing upright collar, diagonal right-side overlapping closure, loose voluminous silhouette with extremely wide rectangular drooping sleeves (bell sleeves) falling straight down past fingertips, long straight-cut hem reaching ankles over matching loose silk trousers.
garments.ao-nhat-binh: Nguyen Dynasty royal court Ao Nhat Binh robe, open-front design fastened with small ties, iconic large stiff rectangular neckband framing chest adorned with 5-colored horizontal embroidered silk bands, embroidered golden five-clawed dragon or phoenix roundels, wide draped flowing sleeves with multicolor ribbon cuffs.
garments.ao-tu-than: Northern Vietnamese Kinh Bac Ao Tu Than folk costume, demure and modest traditional etiquette, four long fluttering silk panels, two back panels sewn together, two front flowing panels draping modestly over the chest and torso before tying gently at the waist, worn over a modest high-coverage traditional silk Yem bib and inner white blouse fully covering the chest and collarbones up to the base of the throat, strictly zero cleavage, no exposed chest, conservative and respectful neckline, bound at waist with a bright flowing silk sash, paired with a dark floor-length flowing wrap skirt.
garments.ao-giao-linh: Historical Vietnamese Ao Giao Linh robe, loose unisex robe, prominent diagonal overlapping crossover V-neck collar where left collar crosses over right, tied securely with a matching cloth waistband, ankle-length flowing layered robe hem.
garments.ao-lap-linh: Vietnamese traditional Lap Linh structured robe, prominent high erect stiff standing neckband collar (mandarin style) completely closed at neck center, seamless right-side diagonal fastener, structured straight shoulders, minimalist historical tailoring.
garments.ao-dai-truyen-thong: Classic Vietnamese female Ao Dai, iconic 2-panel long dress, fitted tightly at waist and chest, high 3cm stiff standing collar, front and back panels hanging down to ankles, side slits cut high up to the ribcage, worn over floor-sweeping loose white silk palazzo trousers.
garments.ao-dai-cach-tan: Modern redesigned Vietnamese Ao Dai, relaxed contemporary silhouette, knee-length short tunic panels, modified collarless scoop neck or low mock neck, elbow-length or puff sleeves, paired with ankle-length wide-leg pleated culottes.

accessories.man-modern: rigid cylindrical layered fabric turban wrapped tightly around the head (Man Tet), flat clean crown.
accessories.silver-choker: solid thick polished circular silver neck ring choker (Vong Kieng), smooth reflective surface without pendant.
accessories.non-quai-thao: large oversized flat disc-shaped straw hat (Non Quai Thao), worn behind shoulders or held, long hanging black silk ribbon straps.
accessories.non-la: traditional pointed conical palm leaf hat (Non La) held at side.
accessories.tui-gam: small rectangular royal silk brocade pouch with gold metallic thread embroidery and hanging tassel.
accessories.tote-coi: minimalist hand-woven natural beige straw basket tote bag with woven handles.

settings.street-walk: sidewalk patio of an aesthetic Indochine-style coffee shop in Saigon, outdoor wooden bistro chairs, warm morning sunlight.
settings.tet-holiday: traditional Lunar New Year Tet festival, blooming pink peach blossom branches, hanging red silk lanterns, festive gold calligraphy banners.
settings.wedding-party: high-end modern wedding hall, floral arrangements with red lotus and silk drapes, warm candlelit illumination.
settings.temple-heritage: ancient courtyard of a Vietnamese Buddhist pagoda, carved dark teak wood pillars, mossy flagstones, faint wisps of incense smoke.
settings.school-presentation: minimalist cultural exhibition stage, stark gallery white floor, soft museum spotlighting on the subject.
settings.y2k-party: contemporary art gallery event, neon accent strip lights, raw concrete walls, vibrant youth social atmosphere.

aesthetics.y2k-neo: Y2K futuristic retro aesthetic, metallic silk sheen, iridescent pastel tints, cyber-nostalgia styling.
aesthetics.streetwear: raw urban high-fashion streetwear, layered utilitarian straps, chunky platform combat boots, dark mood lighting.
aesthetics.minimal-chic: monochrome muted earth tones, Scandinavian-Asian minimalist clean lines, diffuse soft daylight, zero clutter.
aesthetics.cyber-retro: Eastern cyberpunk mood, glowing neon cyan and crimson rim lights casting reflections on silk, high-contrast shadows.
aesthetics.vintage-academia: 1930s French Indochine vintage film photography, nostalgic sepia and celadon green color grading, subtle 35mm film grain.
